newsitem.title: NORWAY: Fire on N. Sea drilling rig quickly put out - Amoc.
newsitem.headline: Fire on N. Sea drilling rig quickly put out - Amoc.

text.p: Amoco Norway said a fire on the Maersk Guardian drilling rig on Wednesday had been manually extinguished and had caused no injuries.
A company statement said the blaze began at 1200 GMT and was put out in "only a few minutes".
The Maersk Guardian is drilling oil wells on the Amoco-operated Valhall field.
"The cause of the field is not known, but preliminary investigations point towards it having started in the mud room ventilation system," Amoco said. No one was in the room when the fire broke out.
The are 79 workers on board the rig.
